intro.default: We combine traditional farming values with modern food-safety standards to bring you dairy you can trust, every single day.

default.title: 100% Grass-Fed
default.text: Our cows graze freely on open, chemical-free pastures for most of the year.

default.title: No Hormones or Antibiotics
default.text: Clean milk with nothing added — tested in our lab before every bottling.

default.title: Same-Day Delivery
default.text: Milked at dawn and at your doorstep before breakfast in chilled vans.

default.title: Animal Welfare First
default.text: Spacious barns, vet care and names for every cow — happy cows make better milk.
